primary_claim: Answer stability does not guarantee stable or faithful visual evidence in a VLM-grounded construction-safety decision pipeline.

system.decision_layer: deterministic person-relative geometry over open-vocabulary grounding

primary_intervention.targeted_mask: black rectangle covering the first rule-relevant object box
primary_intervention.control_mask: black rectangle with identical clipped width and height at a seeded random location
primary_intervention.control_overlap_policy: sample up to 200 locations seeking target-box IoU <= 0.05; otherwise retain the minimum-IoU candidate and report overlap

outcomes.answer_change: perturbed verdict differs from baseline verdict
outcomes.genuine_answer_change: answer change without loss of the baseline worker detection
outcomes.disappearance: baseline object exists and perturbed object does not

statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the two primary paired tests

claim_boundaries: No claim of native end-to-end visual question answering.
No claim of deployment readiness or autonomous inspection.
No claim that technical explanation faithfulness creates calibrated human trust.
No confirmatory class-level claim for a subgroup with n < 30.
